name: O mar em todos os cantos da casa
description: This event is part of "O Meu Primeiro FITEI" and explores stories, memories, and myths of a community. It combines theatre, music, and plastic arts to express the identity of each place.
longDescription:
The event "O mar em todos os cantos da casa" is part of "O Meu Primeiro FITEI" and takes place on October 29 and 30, 2026, at 9:30 PM. It is held at the Antiga Fábrica Vasco da Gama in Matosinhos.

This event is a journey through the stories, memories, and myths of a community. It integrates theatre, music, and plastic arts to give voice to the identity of each location.

Admission is free, subject to available capacity. Reservations can be made by emailing reservas@fitei.com.

longDescriptionPt:

Este evento é uma viagem pelas histórias, memórias e mitos de uma comunidade. Integra teatro, música e artes plásticas para dar voz à identidade de cada local.
